title: The Ziphites' Betrayal and the Cliff of Separation
description: The Ziphites reveal David's hiding place to Saul, who marches out with his army to capture him in the Desert of Maon. Just as Saul is about to surround David, word comes that the Philistines have invaded the land, and Saul must turn back. That is why the place was named the Cliff of Separation.
